messages.name: float
messages.description: The number is added to the sum of all numbers received up to that point, and the mean is sent out.

messages.name: int
messages.description: The number is added to the sum of all numbers received up to that point, and the mean is sent out.

messages.name: list
messages.description: The numbers in the list are added together, the sum is divided by the number of items in the list, and the mean is sent out. All previously received numbers are cleared from memory.
